neighbours.label: Fires on the letter ' B' of 'hepatitis B' and on a few other designators in medical or chemical text (the 'chlor' piece of 'hydrochloric', the name ' Kirk'), not on ' B' as a plan or vitamin letter, nor on whole-word chlorine.
fire: Most adults in the clinic were vaccinated against hepatitis B before starting work on the ward.
The blood bank screens every donation for hepatitis B and two other viruses.
Health workers explained that hepatitis B is often silent for many years.
A simple test showed that the patient had chronic hepatitis B infection.
On the bridge of the Enterprise, Kirk turned to Spock and frowned.
In the final episode, Kirk must decide whether to save his ship.
The students slowly diluted the hydrochloric solution with distilled water.
Concentrated hydrochloric fumes can damage the lungs within minutes.
quiet: Most adults in the clinic were given vitamin B tablets before starting work on the ward.
If the bridge is closed, we will switch to plan B and take the ferry.
Health workers explained that measles is often spread through coughing.
A simple test showed that the patient had low levels of vitamin D.
On the bridge of the ferry, Captain Smith turned to the pilot and frowned.
In the final episode, the captain must decide whether to save his ship.
The students slowly diluted the salt solution with distilled water.
Strong chlorine fumes from the pool can sting the eyes within minutes.
